title: A novel arsenic complex of zirconium(III)
abstract: The prolonged reaction of zirconium tetrachloride with 1,2- bis(dimethylarsino)-3,3,4,4-tetrafluoro-cyclobutene (tfars) in acetonitrile forms [ZrCl3(tfars)] MeCN. This compound appears to be the first magnetically dilute complex of zirconium(III).
